name: Sunrakshakk Industries India Limited
summary: Sunrakshakk Industries India Limited, an Indian enterprise established in 1994 and headquartered in Bhilwara, primarily focuses on the production, processing, and distribution of textile goods within the country. Its operations are structured into two key divisions: Textiles and Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG). Within the FMCG segment, the company manufactures and supplies a broad spectrum of items, including but not limited to soaps, noodles, toothpastes, detergents, cosmetics, as well as various intermediate chemicals, moulding materials, and home care solutions. The firm, which was formerly known as A.K. Spintex Limited, officially rebranded to Sunrakshakk Industries India Limited in April 2025.
